text: This is the image room where your first training program begins. In this room, you will have an advance look into the job of your choice.

name: Sera
text: Once you train hard enough, you will be entitled to occupy a job. You can become a Bowman in Henesys, a Magician in Ellinia, a Warrior in Perion, and a Thief in Kerning City..
